privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.controller.h: 1. Who we are and how to reach us
privacy.controller.body:
The controller is MK Digital s. r. o., Medená 15387/2, 974 05 Banská Bystrica, Slovakia, company number 55 450 229, registered in the Commercial Register of the Municipal Court Banská Bystrica, section Sro, insert 47559/S, e-mail admin@mkdigital.sk.

We have not designated a data protection officer — our processing does not require one.
privacy.data.body:
When you create an account we process your e-mail address and your password. We do not store the password — only a cryptographic hash of it, from which the original cannot be recovered.

We also store your theme and language preference, and the times the account was created and last changed. We do not collect your name.
privacy.purpose.body:
We process the e-mail and the password hash to create and run your account — to register you, sign you in, and show you your own data. Without them the service cannot exist. Legal basis: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract).

Theme and language preferences are processed on the same basis, as part of the service. Timestamps are processed on our legitimate interest in keeping an administrative and security record of the account, Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. You may object to that processing.

We do not use the data for marketing and never sell it.
privacy.obligation.h: 4. Do you have to provide this?
privacy.obligation.body:
The e-mail and password are a contractual requirement — without them we cannot create the account. We ask for nothing else.

We do not verify the address and send no marketing to it.
privacy.recipients.body:
These processors handle the data on our behalf: Railway Corporation (USA) — application server; Neon (Databricks, Inc., USA) — the database the account is stored in; Vercel Inc. (USA) — hosting for this web application.

The mobile showcase apps (Android, iOS, React Native) additionally use Google (Firebase) for notification delivery and crash reporting. This web application uses none of those.

We do not give or sell the data to anyone else.
privacy.transfers.body:
Those processors are US-based companies, so a transfer to a third country takes place. Choosing a European storage region does not change this — what governs is where the provider is established, not where the server sits.

The transfer relies on the European Commission adequacy decision for the EU–US Data Privacy Framework (Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1795) where the provider is certified under it, and alongside that on the Commission Standard Contractual Clauses (Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/914). We will provide a copy of the safeguards used on request at admin@mkdigital.sk.
privacy.retention.body:
We keep the data while you have an account. When you delete the account, we delete it.

These are demonstration applications, so we also remove inactive accounts without waiting for you to ask. Backups are overwritten on the ordinary backup cycle.
privacy.rights.body:
Under the GDPR you have the right of access (Art 15), rectification (Art 16), erasure (Art 17), restriction of processing (Art 18) and data portability (Art 20). You may object under Art 21 to the processing we base on legitimate interest (the timestamps).

You can delete your account in the app itself. For the other rights, write to admin@mkdigital.sk.
privacy.complaint.body:
If you believe we process your data unlawfully, you may file a proposal to commence proceedings on the protection of personal data under § 100 of Act No. 18/2018 Coll.

Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov Slovenskej republiky, Galvaniho Business Centrum II, Galvaniho 7/B, 821 04 Bratislava, Slovakia, e-mail statny.dozor@pdp.gov.sk, web dataprotection.gov.sk.
privacy.automated.body: We carry out no automated decision-making and no profiling.
privacy.changes.body:
We may update this notice. The version in force is the one published here, carrying the effective date shown at the top.

The Slovak version is the original and governs; other languages are translations.
